evidence_type: Read-only current Android source inspection; no app/runtime/storage durability tests.

existing.fact: Text debug log is written/reloaded/exported by design; it already records selected image and transfer hashes. Truncation and ignored write errors limit completeness/durability.
Optional per-page readback comparison exists; policy can skip it. E receipt completes END state; its payload semantics and postboot execution remain unknown.
File SHA and planned transfer-payload SHA are calculated; neither measures a received hardware image.
OTA/session objects start afresh; only text history/tab is restored by the observed source paths.
Revision remains unknown; A0 prefix cannot prove a complete revision fingerprint.
Separate atomic hardware capture exists; UI excludes starting OTA while capture is active, so it does not supply a complete OTA session journal.

gap: No structured per-session, durable OTA evidence receipt linking image/transfer identity, readback policy/results, END acknowledgment and separately sourced postboot/runtime/function observations.
proposal: Local session-keyed append/atomic receipt history; reopening displays past evidence without auto-resuming transmission. Default excludes UID/VIN/MAC and unreviewed raw payloads.
